title: A Friendly Monster
description: Linh draws a big green monster called Bobo.
instructions: Read about Bobo the monster. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 👾 Linh draws a monster. Its name is Bobo. He is big and green, but he is very friendly.
Bobo has got three eyes. They are big and round. He has got a small red nose.
He has got a very big mouth and four white teeth. He can smile all day.
Bobo has got two long arms and six fingers. He has got big yellow feet.
Linh says, 'Bobo, you are my best friend!' Bobo smiles and waves his hand.
